title: Credits Programme Standard: Amount of the Small Business Electricity Supply Renewal Loyalty Credit
content:
**Standard.** The standard loyalty credit on a renewed Small Business Electricity Supply agreement is the renewal loyalty credit of the plan renewed into, rounded half up to the cent. The plan renewed into is the plan recorded on the agreement for its renewed term, and its renewal loyalty credit is the figure that plan sets; a plan whose renewal loyalty credit is 0.00 gives a plan-based credit of 0.00.

## Order of working

The credit is put together in this order: first the dollar amounts that make up the credit, among them the amount standing for the plan's loyalty credit, are added into one loyalty subtotal; any multiplication of that subtotal comes next; the result is rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

| Stage | What it holds |
|---|---|
| Loyalty subtotal | the dollar amounts of the credit added together, the amount standing for the plan's loyalty credit among them |
| Multiplication | the loyalty subtotal multiplied, where a multiplier is set |
| Credit | the result, rounded half up to the cent; no earlier figure is rounded |

## Hypothetical worked example

An agreement renewed into a plan whose renewal loyalty credit is a hypothetical 80.00 USD: the loyalty subtotal is 80.00 USD and the credit, rounded half up to the cent at the end, is 80.00 USD, entered as a positive credit amount and shown on the bill as a reduction.
